title: Frequently Asked Questions
snippet:
The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts. Both have full access to the API and the same base rate Limit A and Limit B apply. There is no extra charge for using the API as long as the usage is within these base rate limits. Paid accounts have an additional capability of upgrading to higher API rate limits by purchasing an API Add-on.

If your API integration requires a higher rate limit, you can request your contract owner to purchase an API Add-on for the relevant API key. The API Add-on increases both Limit A and Limit B, with multiple tiers available to suit different usage requirements. See the [product documentation](https://progress.com/podio/documentation/using-podio/upgrade-and-billing/what-add-ons-in-podio)

title: Podio Troubleshooting & FAQs Podio Hybrid Pricing FAQ - Progress Podio
snippet:
Are API base limits changing? No. Standard included API limits remain based on the existing two-limit model:
- **Limit A:** 250 API calls per hour for resource-intensive API calls.
- **Limit B:** 1,000 API calls per hour for all other API calls.
These limits are measured on a rolling-hour basis. Customers who need API capacity above the included limits can purchase an API Add-on once add-ons become available.
